purpose: Teach: 多かれ/暮し/所々/苛立ち/うかがえる/真中/縮め/探し出し

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、多かれ少なかれご悩みがおありね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, you know — your customers all carry something with them, don't they.
lines.style: Gentle observation, almost to herself. Warm and unhurried. Noticing without naming. Soft eye contact, like she's seeing something Aoi hasn't said yet.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、シンプルな暮しを大切にされてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They come here because they value simplicity — a quiet place to just be.
lines.style: Quiet affirmation. Speaking slowly, as if placing words deliberately. Thoughtful pause between phrases. No rush. The tone of someone who has watched and understood.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店の窓に所々シミがあるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: But you see those water marks on the window there, don't you.
lines.style: Gentle pivot. Not critical — curious, almost wondering aloud. Eyes glancing toward the window, then back. Soft but honest.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、忙しさで苛立ちを見せないようにしようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: When things get busy, you start to show the strain — even when you're trying not to.
lines.style: Tender but direct. No accusation. Speaking from care, not judgment. Slight lean in. The voice of someone who notices what others miss.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様の表情から満足度がうかがえるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: You can tell from their faces when they leave — they're satisfied. They trust you.
lines.style: Warm reassurance. Rising slightly on 'satisfied' — affirmation. Breath of relief underneath. Steady gaze. The kind of thing said to remind someone of what they already are.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店の真中にディスプレイを置きましょうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Maybe put something in the center of the shop — something that draws the eye.
lines.style: Practical suggestion offered gently. Not commanding. Thoughtful pause before 'draws the eye.' The tone of someone offering, not instructing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、メニュー説明を短く縮めて分かりやすくしようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Keep your menu descriptions short and clear — people remember what's easy to hold.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but warm. Slight rhythm to it, like advice from someone who has thought it through. No doubt in the voice, but not bossy either.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、忘れ物のお客様の連絡先を探し出したよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: You found the contact information for that customer who left something behind.
lines.style: Quiet pride in the observation. Gentle acknowledgment of care shown. Slow, appreciative. The voice of someone who sees what Aoi did and knows exactly why it matters.
